newsitem.title: USA: Brazil must correct overvalued real -- Dornbusch.
newsitem.headline: Brazil must correct overvalued real -- Dornbusch.

text.p: Brazil must correct the overvaluation of the real in order to promote growth, M.I.T. economics and management professor Rudiger Dornbusch said in an interview with Reuters Financial Television.

"I continue to believe the large overvaluation of the Brazilian currency ultimately -- I don't mean next month or even early next year -- must be corrected for them to have very strong growth," Dornbusch said.
Brazil has several options to reduce overvaluation, the economist said.
"How that is done is wide open, including dramatic productivity gains economy-wide through much better reform," Dornbusch said.
An additional 5.0 percent depreciation of the real over five years "would get them out of the problem and nobody would have a heart attack," he said.
